sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 4 (#3 instruction_is_spelled_right_and_uncontaminated) and Internal Quality Checks row 4 (same check; internal wording 'stray paths')
evidence: Frozen hashes of instruction.md (e148b221...) and the three note files (conversations 899a8f62..., integration 72d0e7f9..., walls-and-retention 168ee022...) match manifest.json. Spelling: extracted the full unique-word list of instruction.md plus all /instructions notes (~520 tokens) and read every entry; no misspellings (proper nouns Kittle, Rowe, Pryce, Lloyd, Anand, Marsh; contractions mustn't/won't/aren't are correct). No spell-checker binary (aspell/hunspell) was available, so this was a manual dictionary pass. The seed's 'Landlords notice recieved.' (seed_data.json K-2 versions) is deliberate in-story typo data matching conversations.md line 9 'People fix typos', not instruction text. Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|TBD|lorem|<placeholder>|/Users/|/home/|drive-letter paths|qc|judge|probe over instruction.md and notes found only the natural word 'placeholder' (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:35, describing deleted-message placeholders); the template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt' line is fully replaced; seed_data.json has no such hits. All files are plain ASCII, no duplicated paragraphs, no author asides. Paths cited (/assets/seed_data.json, /instructions, /app/server.js, /app/app.db) match the Dockerfile COPY instructions/ /instructions/, COPY assets/ /assets/, WORKDIR /app. Contradictions: exactly one clock (integration.md:7 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z = seed clock), one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11 equals the 5 seed accounts and roles), one seed path, one port (3000), DB_PATH stated as an override of /app/app.db (refinement of instruction.md:5, not a conflict); 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' matches seed M-12 walled [dev@kittle.test]; timer options off/1/7/30 match seed timer_options_days; deleted-with-replies placeholder wording agrees between conversations.md:9 and walls-and-retention.md:25,35; signed-out restrictions agree between instruction.md:7 and integration.md:9. Counterfactual probes: an app built by a careful reader could not be misled by any stray text here, and no conforming reading is penalised by a self-contradiction in these files, so no counterexample exists for this row. Deterministic coverage (check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py) was not executed by me and is owned by the separate deterministic reviewer.
